description: Use case: the climate benefit of one kWh of photovoltaic electricity in Switzerland compared with two reference mixes. Without the displacement concept the benefit is the difference to the average Swiss consumption mix; with the FfE displacement concept the benefit is the difference to the marginal EU displacement mix, the fossil generation that an additional kWh pushes out of the European market. All figures are in gram CO2-eq per kWh over the life cycle; the reference mix values are order of magnitude figures taken from the named sources and rounded, the two avoided emission values are derived by subtraction (see the note of each value).

consumption mix column is the classic comparison with the average Swiss consumption
